title: Central bank holds key rate steady
text: The central bank kept its benchmark repo rate unchanged at 6.5 percent on Thursday, citing persistent food inflation, the governor said in a statement. Economists polled by the agency had expected no change. The monetary policy committee voted five to one in favour of the decision.

title: Monsoon rainfall 4 percent above average
text: India received 4 percent more rainfall than the long-period average during the June to September monsoon season, the meteorological department said on Monday. Officials said reservoir levels in the western states had improved compared with last year.

title: City council approves new metro line
text: The city council on Tuesday approved a 22-kilometre metro extension connecting the airport to the central business district. According to the project report, construction is expected to take four years and cost an estimated 9,800 crore rupees, funded jointly by the state and central governments.

title: University announces revised exam schedule
text: The state university has revised its semester examination schedule after several colleges requested more time, a spokesperson told reporters. Theory examinations will now begin on December 4, and the revised timetable has been published on the official website.

title: Retail inflation eases to 4.8 percent
text: Retail inflation eased to 4.8 percent in October from 5.1 percent in September, data from the statistics ministry showed on Wednesday. Vegetable prices declined for the second straight month while cereal prices remained elevated.

title: Hospital opens new cardiac care unit
text: The district hospital inaugurated a 40-bed cardiac care unit on Saturday. The health department said the facility includes two catheterisation labs and will reduce the need for patients to travel to the state capital for angioplasty procedures.

title: Tech firm reports quarterly profit rise
text: The software services company reported a 9 percent rise in quarterly net profit on Thursday, helped by large deals in North America. Revenue grew 6 percent year on year, the company said in a regulatory filing, and it maintained its full-year guidance.

title: Researchers publish study on groundwater
text: A team of researchers at the institute published a study in a peer-reviewed journal showing groundwater levels in 12 districts declined by an average of 0.4 metres per year over the last decade. The authors recommended stricter regulation of borewell drilling.

title: Election commission announces poll dates
text: The Election Commission on Friday announced that assembly elections in the state will be held in two phases on November 7 and November 14. Votes will be counted on November 23, the chief election commissioner told a press conference in New Delhi.

title: Government launches crop insurance portal
text: The agriculture ministry launched an online portal that allows farmers to register crop insurance claims and track their status. Officials said more than 2 lakh farmers had registered in the first week of the pilot across three states.

title: Police arrest two in bank fraud case
text: Police arrested two people on Monday in connection with a loan fraud involving forged documents at a cooperative bank, officials said. The accused were produced before a magistrate and remanded in police custody for five days, according to the investigating officer.

title: National team names squad for series
text: The national cricket selectors on Sunday named a 16-member squad for the upcoming five-match series. The chairman of selectors said two uncapped fast bowlers had been included after strong domestic performances last season.

title: Airline adds daily flights to Singapore
text: The airline said on Tuesday it will add a second daily flight between Mumbai and Singapore from next month to meet growing demand. Bookings open this week, a company spokesperson said, adding that the route will use narrow-body aircraft.

title: WHO reports decline in malaria cases
text: The World Health Organization said in its annual report that estimated malaria cases in the region declined by 8 percent compared with the previous year. The report attributed the decline to wider distribution of insecticide-treated nets and improved diagnosis.

title: State budget raises education spending
text: The state finance minister presented the annual budget on Wednesday, raising education spending by 11 percent to 42,000 crore rupees. The budget also allocated funds for 500 new classrooms and teacher recruitment, according to budget documents.

title: Court adjourns hearing in land dispute
text: The High Court on Thursday adjourned the hearing in a long-running land acquisition dispute to January 12 after the state sought more time to file its reply. The petitioners had challenged the compensation awarded for land acquired for a highway project.

title: Automaker recalls 12,000 vehicles
text: The automaker said on Friday it would recall about 12,000 vehicles to replace a faulty fuel pump component. The company said in a statement that no accidents had been reported and that the replacement would be carried out free of charge at authorised dealers.

title: Space agency completes engine test
text: The space agency successfully completed a 200-second hot test of its semi-cryogenic engine at its propulsion complex on Monday, officials said. The engine is being developed for the heavy-lift launch vehicle planned for later this decade.

title: Stock index ends higher on bank gains
text: The benchmark stock index closed 0.6 percent higher on Tuesday, led by gains in banking and energy shares. Foreign institutional investors were net buyers for the third consecutive session, provisional exchange data showed.

title: Railways to electrify remaining routes
text: The railway ministry said it plans to complete electrification of the remaining 1,200 route kilometres of broad-gauge track by March. A senior official said the move would reduce diesel consumption and operating costs.

title: Survey finds rise in smartphone use among students
text: A national survey of 25,000 households found that 68 percent of school students had access to a smartphone at home, up from 52 percent three years ago. The survey was conducted by an independent research organisation and released on Wednesday.

title: Flood relief camps set up in district
text: District authorities set up 35 relief camps after heavy rainfall caused rivers to overflow, the collector said on Sunday. About 4,200 people have been moved to safer locations and the disaster response force has deployed six teams, officials said.

title: Ministry issues advisory on heatwave
text: The health ministry issued an advisory urging people to avoid outdoor activity between noon and 4 pm as temperatures crossed 44 degrees Celsius in several northern districts. Hospitals have been asked to keep dedicated beds for heat-related illness.

title: Port records highest monthly cargo volume
text: The port handled 6.1 million tonnes of cargo in August, its highest monthly volume, the port authority said in a statement. Container traffic rose 14 percent from a year earlier, driven by higher exports of engineering goods.

title: Scientists sequence genome of rice variety
text: Scientists at the agricultural research institute have sequenced the genome of a drought-tolerant rice variety, according to a paper published this week. The researchers said the data could help breeders develop varieties suited to low-rainfall regions.

title: Municipal corporation begins road repair drive
text: The municipal corporation began a month-long drive to repair potholes on 180 roads, the commissioner said on Monday. The work will be carried out at night to reduce traffic disruption, and residents can report potholes through a helpline.

title: Pharmaceutical company receives drug approval
text: The pharmaceutical company said on Thursday it had received approval from the drug regulator to market a generic version of a diabetes medication. Shares of the company rose 3 percent after the announcement.

title: Power demand hits record high
text: Peak electricity demand reached a record 243 gigawatts on Friday, the power ministry said, as temperatures rose across the country. Officials said supply was met without major outages due to higher coal stocks at thermal plants.

title: Library digitises rare manuscripts
text: The state central library has digitised more than 3,000 rare manuscripts with support from a national heritage mission, the librarian said. The digital copies will be made available to researchers through an online catalogue next year.

title: Exports rise for third consecutive month
text: Merchandise exports rose 7 percent year on year in September, the commerce ministry said on Monday, marking the third consecutive month of growth. The trade deficit narrowed to 19 billion dollars as gold imports declined.

title: Telecom regulator releases consultation paper
text: The telecom regulator released a consultation paper on spectrum pricing for satellite broadband services on Tuesday. Stakeholders have been asked to submit comments within 30 days, the regulator said in a press release.

title: Farmers receive delayed subsidy payments
text: The state agriculture department said it had transferred delayed subsidy payments to about 1.3 lakh farmers on Friday. Officials told reporters that verification issues with bank accounts had caused the delay.

title: Museum to reopen after renovation
text: The national museum will reopen to the public on December 1 after an 18-month renovation that added climate-controlled galleries, the culture ministry said. Entry will be free for students during the first week.

title: New traffic rules to take effect next month
text: New traffic rules requiring helmets for pillion riders will take effect from next month, the transport department said in a notification. Fines for violations will be collected through an electronic challan system, officials said.

title: Study links air pollution to hospital visits
text: A study published in a medical journal found that hospital visits for respiratory illness rose by 12 percent on days with high particulate pollution in the city. The researchers analysed records from five hospitals over three years.

title: Water supply to be suspended for maintenance
text: Water supply in parts of the eastern suburbs will be suspended for 12 hours on Saturday for pipeline maintenance, the water works department said. Residents have been advised to store water in advance.

title: Startup raises funding for battery technology
text: The battery technology startup said it raised 40 million dollars in a funding round led by a venture capital firm. The company plans to use the funds to expand its manufacturing facility, its chief executive said in an interview.

title: Coast guard rescues fishermen
text: The coast guard rescued 11 fishermen whose boat developed engine trouble about 40 nautical miles off the coast on Tuesday, a defence spokesperson said. All the fishermen were reported to be safe and were brought to the harbour.

title: Census data collection to begin in April
text: The registrar general said on Wednesday that house listing operations for the census will begin in April. Enumerators will use a mobile application to collect data, according to an official notification.

title: Court acquits accused in decade-old case
text: A sessions court on Monday acquitted three people accused in a 2014 assault case, citing insufficient evidence. The prosecution said it would study the judgment before deciding whether to file an appeal.
